name: Alex Taylor
title: Customer Operations Specialist
contact: linkedin.com/in/alex-taylor-example  |  Right to work in the UK (no sponsorship required)
summary: Customer operations specialist with seven years in payments and B2B software, most recently the only operations specialist covering the UK and Ireland for a card-issuing platform. My work has always sat where a small error reaches someone's money, and I am usually the one who finds it: I review my own case log daily and follow anything that does not look right until the cause is proven and fixed. I keep cases open until they close, chasing counterparties myself rather than passing the problem on, and I explain where a case stands in plain language. I am applying to bring that discipline and ownership to an operation where every case carries a deadline and a customer waiting on the other side.

experience.title: Operations Specialist
experience.scope: Sole UK and Ireland operations specialist for card payments; partner to a five-person outsourced support team.
bullets: Held a 97% SLA attainment rate on around 250 cases a week by triaging the queue daily and chasing card schemes directly.
Cut repeat card-activation enquiries by about 40% in one quarter by analysing contact reasons and rewriting the in-app help text with product.
Trained a five-person outsourced team on internal tools and SOPs, taking them from launch to independent handling in six weeks.
Isolated provider faults from platform faults by reading API error codes and logs, shortening incident triage for engineering.
Found a refund configuration error by running the refund journey end to end, preventing incorrect refunds before release.
Wrote a searchable knowledge base the outsourced team used instead of memorising SOPs, lifting daily handling per agent by a third.
Produced a fortnightly voice-of-customer report turning ticket data into product fixes, three of which shipped within the year.

experience.title: Customer Support Executive
